mapper.sql: pv_requests.id AS id, pv_requests.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, COALESCE( (SELECT order_id FROM pv_request_orders WHERE pv_request_id = pv_requests.id LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM purchase_orders WHERE status > 0 AND pv_request_id = pv_requests.id) ) AS purchaseId, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pv_request_orders WHERE pv_request_id = pv_requests.id AND status = 2 ) THEN 2 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pv_request_orders WHERE pv_request_id = pv_requests.id AND status = 3 ) THEN 3 END AS purchaseType, COALESCE( (SELECT pr_code FROM purchase_requests WHERE status > 0 AND id IN (SELECT order_id FROM pv_request_orders WHERE status = 2 AND pv_request_id = pv_requests.id)), (SELECT po_code FROM purchase_orders WHERE status > 0 AND id IN (SELECT order_id FROM pv_request_orders WHERE status = 3 AND pv_request_id = pv_requests.id)) ) AS purchaseCode, IFNULL(pv_requests.ref_doc, "") AS refDocUrl, IFNULL(pv_requests.ref_doc_name, "") AS refDocName, pv_requests.order_date AS erDate, pv_requests.code AS erNumber, pv_requests.vendor_id AS vendorId, CONCAT(v.name, " (", (SELECT name FROM payment_terms WHERE id = v.payment_term_id LIMIT 1), ")") AS vendorName, pv_requests.expected_delivery_date AS expectedErDate, pv_requests.vat_setting_id AS vatId, vat_settings.name AS vatName, vat_settings.vat_percent AS vatPercent, CASE WHEN (COALESCE( (SELECT pr_code FROM purchase_requests WHERE status > 0 AND id IN (SELECT order_id FROM pv_request_orders WHERE status = 2 AND pv_request_id = pv_requests.id)), (SELECT po_code FROM purchase_orders WHERE status > 0 AND id IN (SELECT order_id FROM pv_request_orders WHERE status = 3 AND pv_request_id = pv_requests.id)) ) IS NOT NULL AND #{filter.isReferSaleOrder} = 0) THEN NULL ELSE IFNULL(pv_requests.total_amount, 0) + IFNULL(pv_requests.total_vat, 0) END AS totalAmount, pv_requests.is_close AS isClose, pv_requests.is_cash_advance AS isCashAdvance, pv_requests.ut_type_of_system_id AS departmentId, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(id) END AS approveDepositAmount FROM pv_request_apply_deposits WHERE pv_request_id = pv_requests.id AND is_approved = 1) AS approveDepositAmount, (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permission_approves WHERE permission_approves.is_active = 1 AND (pv_requests.total_amount + IFNULL(pv_requests.total_vat, 0)) BETWEEN permission_approves.from_amount AND permission_approves.to_amount AND ((permission_approves.is_cash_advance = 0 AND pv_requests.is_cash_advance = 0) OR (permission_approves.is_cash_advance = 1)) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permission_approve_details WHERE permission_approve_details.status = 1 AND permission_approve_details.permission_approve_id = permission_approves.id AND permission_approve_details.user_id = #{userId} ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM permission_approve_projects WHERE permission_approve_projects.status = 1 AND permission_approve_projects.permission_approve_id = permission_approves.id AND permission_approve_projects.ut_type_of_system_id = pv_requests.ut_type_of_system_id ) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS isAllowApproval, pv_requests.note AS note, pv_requests.status AS status, pv_requests.closed AS closed, pv_requests.approved AS approved, pv_requests.created AS created, pv_requests.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users4.first_name, ' ', users4.last_name) AS closedBy, CONCAT(users3.first_name, ' ', users3.last_name) AS approvedBy, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM pv_requests AS pv_requests LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = pv_requests.company_id LEFT JOIN vendors AS v ON pv_requests.vendor_id = v.id LEFT JOIN vat_settings ON vat_settings.id = pv_requests.vat_setting_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = pv_requests.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = pv_requests.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = pv_requests.modified_by LEFT JOIN users AS users3 ON users3.id = pv_requests.approved_by LEFT JOIN users AS users4 ON users4.id = pv_requests.closed_by
